properties.name: activiti.dmn.engine
properties.description: Engine that evaluates decisions: operaton (default) or kie (needs the module activiti-dmn-connector-kie).

properties.name: activiti.dmn.enabled
properties.description: Whether to register the connector bean dmn-connector.EXECUTE_TABLE and the evaluation service.

properties.name: activiti.dmn.cache-size
properties.description: How many parsed DMN documents, resolved deployments and process definition lookups each cache keeps.

values.description: Operaton DMN (default), with PRIORITY and OUTPUT ORDER added by the connector.
Apache KIE DMN: business knowledge models, boxed expressions, decision services.
